mapper.select: SELECT v.id AS vehicle_id, v.name AS vehicle_name, v.status AS vehicle_status, v.battery, v.location, COUNT(DISTINCT dt.id) AS total_tasks, SUM(CASE WHEN dt.status = 'completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed_tasks, SUM(CASE WHEN dt.status = 'executing' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_tasks, COUNT(DISTINCT fa.id) AS alert_count FROM vehicle v LEFT JOIN dispatch_task dt ON v.id = dt.vehicle_id LEFT JOIN fault_alert fa ON v.id = fa.vehicle_id AND fa.status = 'active' GROUP BY v.id, v.name, v.status, v.battery, v.location ORDER BY v.name
